about: USDA Forest Service Land Areas Report FY2025 (data as of 2025-09-30): NFS acres (the land the Forest Service owns) for every whole national forest and grassland (Table 3) and every administrative unit (Table 28). Copied from LAR_FY2025.xlsx, which the owner downloaded by hand from the Forest Service's Box folder (robots.txt there blocks bots). State portions and 'part in' rows are left out: they are pieces, not a whole park. Source rows: KPC-Store key-quality/2026-11-19/kitC-acreage/answers/kitC-usfs-acres.answers.csv.
